name: @tiehall/testing
description: Shared test harness: one Testcontainers Postgres 17 per Vitest project, a fresh database per test file, a setup file that fails a test file using pg in a way pg 9 removes, a local SMTP test server, the GitHub stub every GitHub test runs against, self-signed certificates for tests that serve HTTPS, and a test issuer of GitHub Actions OIDC tokens.
